title: Flat scalar restriction preserves K-flat complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\varphi:R\to B$ a homomorphism of commutative ring sheaves. Use sheaf modules, sheaf tensor, total tensor of cochain complexes, K-flatness, flatness, and restriction of scalars as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Assume $B$ is flat over $R$. If $P$ is a possibly unbounded K-flat $B$-complex, then $\operatorname{Res}P$ is K-flat over $R$. If every term of $P$ is flat over $B$, every term of $\operatorname{Res}P$ is flat over $R$.
